label: No acceleration
try: The map, the keyboard on it. Tap an arrow slowly, then as fast as you can: every tap is one tile. Hold an arrow: it keeps going at a steady pace and never speeds up. Shift with an arrow jumps ten tiles; hold Shift and an arrow to keep jumping. Press d to change anything under KEYBOARD NAVIGATION.

label: Shift is slow
try: Arrows move five tiles, Shift with an arrow moves one: Shift is the precise move, the arrow the quick one. Tap, hold, and nudge with Shift. In a menu or a list the arrows still move one row.

label: The way it was
try: Both accelerations back on. Tap three times, the last one quick: the third moves two. Three more and it moves four. Hold an arrow for a second: it goes two tiles a move.

label: Taps speed up
try: Quick runs of taps speed up as they did (1, 1, 2, then 2, 2, 4), but a held arrow stays at one steady pace.

label: Holds go further
try: Taps are always one tile. Hold an arrow for a second and each move goes two tiles.

label: Fast hold
try: No acceleration, and a held arrow moves at every repeat your keyboard sends instead of the game's steady pace. Hold an arrow and compare. Hold pace, under KEYBOARD NAVIGATION, brings the game's pace back.
